original_target.title: Strong comparison for ordered p-harmonic fields
original_target.area: Nonlinear elliptic PDEs and comparison principles

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "strong comparison" "p-harmonic" (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com) proof

sources.scope: Requires one comparison function C2 and its horizontal gradient bounded below near contact. Hence does not include common critical contact.
Fractional subquadratic p-Laplacian equation; not the local unweighted operator.
Weighted/metric Green-function setting; no unweighted higher-dimensional all-p-harmonic resolution inferred.

registry_checks: Complete cached Palomar/Hexagon metadata and pinned OpenAI/Colbrook author listings scanned for target terms; no full matching claim. Palomar planar Steklov isospectrality is a different question.
scope_comparison: The full target specifically allows both gradients to vanish at contact for any d>=3,p!=2. Noncritical comparison, constant comparison, weighted or nonlocal results do not settle it.
limitations: Bjorn etal institutional fullPDF timed out; candidate Capogna theorem body was readable and excludes critical case.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement; retain Open.
